title: UI/UX & Frontend Engineer
description:
Description:

Design the website layout (Home, Services, Contact, Dashboard).

Build responsive pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript (or React).
Ensure mobile-friendly and user-friendly interface.
Add icons for repair categories (Plumbing, Electrical, Carpentry, etc.).
Implement booking form and navigation menus.

title: Server & Database Engineer
description:
Description:

Set up backend using Node.js/Express (or Django/Java).
Create APIs for booking, cost estimator, and service tracking.
Manage user authentication and technician profiles.
Design and connect database (MySQL/MongoDB) for storing service requests, user data, and repair history.
Ensure secure payment integration and data protection.

title: Project Coordinator & Quality Analyst
description:
Description:

Define project roadmap, assign tasks, and track progress.
Write documentation (features list, workflow, user guide).
Test frontend and backend for bugs, usability, and performance.
Collect feedback and ensure smooth deployment.
Handle communication between team and stakeholders.
